_comment: Requirements registry: the single source of truth for requirement -> test traceability. Each requirement lists the test descriptions that cover it; those strings MUST exactly match the JUnit <testcase name> values (the 2nd argument to RUN_TEST in tests/*.c). tools/gen_dashboard.py joins these against the JUnit reports to compute coverage and warns on any mismatch (unknown test name, or test not mapped to any requirement). Update this file whenever requirements or tests change.

requirements.title: Capacity & bounds: count <= VMA_CAP and as_min <= as_max
tests: Boundary split is atomic at capacity (ENOMEM, no mutation)

requirements.title: Per-VMA validity: in-bounds, non-empty, page-aligned, prot within PROT_ALL
tests: Arithmetic guards: overflow detection & page rounding
Splitting a file-backed VMA advances file_offset correctly

requirements.title: Sorted & disjoint: vmas[k].end <= vmas[k+1].start for all k
Canonical form: no adjacent mergeable pair left unmerged
tests: Canonicalize merges adjacent compatible VMAs only

requirements.title: MAP_FIXED overlays the range: split boundaries, remove covered, insert new
tests: MAP_FIXED overlay splits the underlying reservation

requirements.title: Non-FIXED placement: honor a free in-bounds hint, else top-down first-fit
tests: Non-FIXED mmap honors a free hint, else first-fit

requirements.title: Reject length==0, prot/flags outside masks, and address/round-up overflow
tests: Arithmetic guards: overflow detection & page rounding

requirements.title: mprotect splits sub-ranges, sets prot, and rejects an unmapped gap (ENOMEM)
tests: mprotect splits sub-ranges & rejects unmapped gaps

requirements.title: munmap removes covered VMAs, tolerates already-unmapped sub-ranges
tests: munmap punches holes & tolerates empty ranges

requirements.title: Operations are all-or-nothing: at capacity, fail with ENOMEM and no mutation
tests: Boundary split is atomic at capacity (ENOMEM, no mutation)

requirements.title: Whole-object PROT_NONE reservation of the total image span
tests: Full ld.so mapping sequence preserves as_wf at each step

requirements.title: Per-PT_LOAD MAP_FIXED file-backed segment mapping with real prot (text R|X, data R|W)
tests: Full ld.so mapping sequence preserves as_wf at each step

requirements.title: bss zero-fill: anonymous R|W pages beyond file content via MAP_FIXED
tests: Full ld.so mapping sequence preserves as_wf at each step

requirements.title: GNU_RELRO: mprotect the relro sub-range of the data segment to read-only
tests: Full ld.so mapping sequence preserves as_wf at each step
